requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle: Pending Approval -> Assigned -> In Progress -> Resolved/Rejected/Suspended. Citizens can register with email confirmation, choose anonymity, and manage notifications. Municipal staff review, assign, and resolve reports, potentially involving external maintainers (with or without system access). The system supports public/private statistics, two-way communication between citizens and operators, and specific role-based workflows.

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to choose whether to make my report anonymous 
So that my name is not shown in the public list of reports.
constraints: Anonymous option protects privacy. Choice made at issue description time.
expected_behaviors: my name is not shown in the public list of reports

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

requirements.text:
As a citizen /unregistered user
I want to see public statistics about reports 
So that I understand trends in city issues.
constraints: Public statistics  (visible on the site) include the number of reports by category and trends by day, week, or month.
expected_behaviors: I understand trends in city issues

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator 
I want to see detailed private statistics 
So that I can monitor usage and performance of the system.
constraints:
Private statistics (for administrators only), in addition to public ones, also include charts and tables about:  
  - number of reports by status  
  - number of reports by type  
  - number of reports by type and status  
  - number of reports by reporter  
  - number of reports by reporter and type  
  - number of reports by reporter, type and status  
  - number of reports by the top 1% of reporters, by type  
  - number of reports by the top 5% of reporters, by type
expected_behaviors: I can monitor usage and performance of the system

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office depending on the problem category.
Rejected reports require an explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Once a report has been inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
The roles of 'municipal public relations officer' and 'municipal administrator' are automatically associated with the Organization Office.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator.
Each maintainer should have their own individual account.
Assignment logic is left to the teams, as done for municipality technical offices.
Comments/information exchanged between a technical office and an external maintainer are report-specific and reserved (not visible to reporter/citizens).
Communication between a technical office and external maintainers without access to Participium is out of scope.
An anonymous user's name is still visible to the staff and only hidden in the Turin map of reports for citizens.
Notifications/messages can be set to either be sent in real time or when the page is refreshed, depending on preference.
Public statistics are visible to unregistered users; Private statistics are for administrators only.
After approval, accepted reports immediately become visible on the Participium portal (map and table).
Unregistered users can view reports on maps but cannot submit reports.
Registration requires email confirmation valid for 30 minutes before use.
edge_cases: If a report is rejected, it does not proceed to Assigned/In Progress states.
If automatic assignment is configured by the administrator, the initial review by the municipal public relations officer is bypassed for that category.
When zooming out on the map, reports are grouped into a cumulative view showing total count.
When zooming in on the map, individual reports show title and reporter name/anonymity status.
If email notifications are disabled in the configuration panel, only platform notifications are sent (unless Telegram bot is used).
Only not closed reports can be followed by citizens.
External maintainers without system access require the technical office staff member to manually update the report to 'Resolved' status after intervention.
If a citizen follows a report, they receive notifications following the same rules as for their own reports.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to the central body responsible for initial verification and rejection explanations.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires the citizen to have provided their Telegram username in the configuration panel.
The 'top 1% of reporters' statistic implies a ranking mechanism based on report volume or engagement metrics not explicitly defined.

External maintainers with system access can move reports from Assigned to In Progress and resolve them, but cannot see internal comments made by technical office staff unless they are part of the exchange (which is reserved).
The 'standard layer' for OpenStreetMap implies a specific default view configuration provided by the system.
CSV download includes all fields visible in the filtered table view.

api_summary.summary: A municipal citizen reporting platform allowing citizens to register/login, submit reports with photos, and track status. Municipal staff (PR, URP, Technical) manage report lifecycle (categorization, review, assignment, status updates). External maintainers can be assigned to resolve issues. Admins manage users/roles/companies. Includes messaging and notifications.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute assignment of a report to an external maintainer. Ensure the report is in 'Assigned' state and the maintainer ID is valid.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a new report via POST /reports with status 'Pending Approval'.
Approve the report via PUT /municipal/reports/{reportId} to move it to 'Assigned' state.
Assign the report to a technical office (simulated prerequisite).
Ensure an external maintainer exists in the system.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the assigned report if it remains in the database after test completion; verify no orphaned assignments exist.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core workflow of requirement PT24, ensuring external maintainers can be correctly linked to reports.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Attempt to assign a report to an external maintainer who has not been assigned to the report yet. Verify that the assignment fails or requires prior assignment logic.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a report via POST /reports.
Approve the report via PUT /municipal/reports/{reportId}.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the report if it remains in the database; verify no partial assignment state exists.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests edge cases where external maintainer assignment logic might fail due to missing prerequisites or invalid states.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of a report assigned to them.
strategy_items.prompt: Attempt to update the status of a report that has not been assigned to an external maintainer. Verify that the operation is rejected.
setup_needed: Authenticate as external maintainer.
Create a report via POST /reports.
Approve the report via PUT /municipal/reports/{reportId}.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the report if it remains in the database; verify no unauthorized status updates occurred.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests negative scenarios where an external maintainer attempts to modify a report they are not authorized to manage.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Assign a report to an external maintainer and then verify that the assignment can be retrieved via GET /messages/reports/{reportId} or similar inspection endpoint.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a report via POST /reports.
Approve the report via PUT /municipal/reports/{reportId}.
Assign the report to an external maintainer via PUT /offices/reports/{reportId}/assign-external.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the report and any associated messages if they remain after test execution; verify no orphaned state exists.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the stateful dependency where assignment must precede further operations, ensuring correct state transitions.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new municipality user account with valid credentials and necessary profile data for the 'municipal public relations officer' role.
setup_needed: Ensure authentication session is active as system administrator.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.

Create a municipality user via POST /admin/users if not already present.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Verifies the role assignment mechanism which is critical for workflow progression.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member sees list of reports assigned to them.

setup_needed: Ensure a valid session exists for a technical office staff member (via /auth/login).
Ensure at least one report exists in the system with status 'Assigned' and assigned to this user.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality for staff members to view their workload as per PT08.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen configures their account (notifications and virtual presence).

Ensure the current user has an existing profile to update.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the ability of a citizen to modify their notification and presence preferences as per PT09.
